title: JavaScript For Loops: Print 1 to 5 with One Loop
description:
Repeat an instruction with a JavaScript for loop. Learn the counter, condition and update by printing the numbers from one through five.

Try answering: Which part of a for loop changes the counter?

Continue learning: open the JavaScript for Beginners playlist on @Techat60.
Subscribe to TECH AT 60 for practical beginner coding lessons.

A for loop can initialize a counter, check a condition, and update it.
Each pass through the loop is called an iteration.

Try it: Print the numbers from one through five with a loop.
